claims.claim: Child Allowance (Kitzvat Yeladim) stops when BL deregisters a returnee and only resumes after Form 628 residency recognition; the parent must (a) confirm residency recognition is processed, (b) register the Israeli bank account at BL, and (c) request retroactive payment from the residency-effective date; the retroactive-payment window is narrow (typically 12 months)
claims.raw_snippet: קצבת ילדים מוקפאת בזמן שתושב חוזר אינו מוכר; היא חוזרת אחרי הכרה בטופס 628. נדרש לרשום את חשבון הבנק בביטוח לאומי ולבקש תשלום רטרואקטיבי מתאריך החלת התושבות; חלון התשלום הרטרואקטיבי מוגבל בדרך כלל ל-12 חודשים.

claims.claim: A returnee's non-Israeli spouse is handled by the Population and Immigration Authority, whose Population Administration is responsible for registry and passports, citizenship and status, visas, FAMILY REUNIFICATION (ichud mishpachot), aliyah and return. That is a separate authority and process from the returnee's own Toshav Chozer recognition at Misrad HaAliyah VeHaKlita.
claims.raw_snippet: מינהל אוכלוסין - אחראי למכלול הנושאים בתחומים של מרשם ודרכונים, אזרחות ומעמד, אשרות, איחוד משפחות, עלייה ושבות.

claims.claim: The Population and Immigration Authority has EXTENDED, until 30.09.2026, the arrangement allowing Israelis to enter and leave Israel on a valid foreign passport. The blanket rule that an Israeli citizen may only enter on an Israeli passport or Teudat Maavar is therefore currently suspended; check the arrangement's status before travel.
claims.raw_snippet: לתשומת לבכם, רשות האוכלוסין וההגירה החליטה להאריך את האפשרות לישראלים להיכנס ולצאת מישראל עם דרכון זר בתוקף עד ל-30.09.2026.

claims.claim: Israeli banks run FATCA/CRS classifications on incoming international transfers and may freeze the funds pending KYC documentation (proof of source, foreign-tax-residency certificate, employment history); returnees with foreign financial accounts may also have Mas Hachnasa Form 5329 reporting obligations above the threshold
claims.raw_snippet: FATCA and CRS classification of Israeli bank accounts for international transfers; banks may hold incoming funds pending KYC documentation including source-of-funds proof and foreign tax residency certificates. Form 5329 (טופס 5329) is the Israel Tax Authority foreign-account declaration form for taxpayers with offshore financial accounts above the reporting threshold.

claims.claim: Customs (mechess) is one of the tax branches unified under the Israel Tax Authority, alongside income tax, real-estate taxation, VAT, purchase tax and stamp duty. Cash-declaration thresholds on entry to Israel under the Money Laundering Prohibition Law 2000 are set by regulation and change; the current figure must be checked on the Israel Tax Authority customs pages or with the Anti-Money-Laundering Authority before it is relied on. No threshold figure is asserted here.
